setName: Speed Duel Starter Decks: Ultimate Predators

Common.name: Adhesion Trap Hole
Common.desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s): Halve that monster(s)'s original ATK.

Common.name: Alinsection
Common.desc: A stag beetle with a saw-like head and arms.

Common.name: Amulet of Ambition
Common.desc: Equip only to a Normal Monster. If it battles a monster with a higher Level, the equipped monster gains 500 ATK x the difference in Levels, during that damage calculation only. When this card is sent to the GY: You can place it on top of your Deck.

Common.name: Anthrosaurus
Common.desc: Dis man-like dinosawz gotta high I.Q., even tho he's lackin' in da strength depawtment. (Kinda like yooz, if ya had a high I.Q.! Nyaah!)

Common.name: Basic Insect
Common.desc: Usually found traveling in swarms, this creature's ideal environment is the forest.

Common.name: Bee List Soldier
Common.desc: You can Tribute this card and 1 face-up Insect monster, except "Bee List Soldier"; draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Beetron
Common.desc: You can send 1 face-up Spell/Trap you control to the GY, then target 1 Level 4 or lower Insect monster in your GY; Special Summon that Insect monster in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Beetron" once per turn.

Common.name: Big Insect
Common.desc: A giant ant that dwells in the jungle, it is powerful whether attacking or defending.

Common.name: Black Stego
Common.desc: If this Attack Position card is targeted for an attack: Change this card to Defense Position.

Common.name: Black Tyranno
Common.desc: If the only cards your opponent controls are Defense Position monsters, this card can attack directly.

Common.name: Card Advance
Common.desc: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your Deck, then place them on the top of the Deck in any order. You can Tribute Summon 1 monster in addition to your Normal Summon/Set this turn. (You can only gain this effect once per turn.)

Common.name: Cocoon of Evolution
Common.desc: You can target 1 "Petit Moth" you control; equip this card from your hand to that target. While equipped by this effect, the original ATK/DEF of that "Petit Moth" becomes the ATK/DEF of "Cocoon of Evolution".

Common.name: Corrosive Scales
Common.desc: Target 1 Insect monster you control; equip this card to it. While you control the equipped monster, your opponent's monsters cannot attack Insect monsters, except the equipped monster. While this card is equipped to a monster, each time your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster(s), OR activates a card or effect, place 1 Scale Counter on each face-up monster they control. Each monster your opponent controls loses 100 ATK/DEF for each Scale Counter it has.

Common.name: Cost Down
Common.desc: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).

Common.name: Crawling Dragon #2
Common.desc: A powerful dragon with teeth that can grind almost anything to dust.

Common.name: Dark Driceratops
Common.desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Common.name: Dark Factory of Mass Production
Common.desc: Target 2 Normal Monsters in your GY; add them to your hand.

Common.name: Dinosaur Kingdom
Common.desc: All Dinosaur monsters gain 300 ATK/DEF.

Common.name: Element Saurus
Common.desc:
Gains the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field.
● FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK.
● EARTH: Negate the effects of Effect Monsters destroyed by battle with this card.

Common.name: Enchanting Fitting Room
Common.desc: Pay 800 LP; excavate the top 4 cards of your Deck and Special Summon all excavated Level 3 or lower Normal Monsters, also, after that, shuffle the rest back into your Deck.

Common.name: Eradicating Aerosol
Common.desc: Destroy all Insect monsters on the field.

Common.name: Forest
Common.desc: All Insect, Beast, Plant, and Beast-Warrior monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF.

Common.name: Gale Lizard
Common.desc: FLIP: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

Common.name: Gentlemander
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. Your opponent's monsters cannot attack any monsters, except this one.

Common.name: Gilasaurus
Common.desc: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If Summoned this way: Activate this effect; your opponent can Special Summon 1 monster from their GY.

Common.name: Gokipon
Common.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can add 1 Insect monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Heat Wave
Common.desc: At the start of your Main Phase 1: Neither player can Normal or Special Summon Effect Monsters, until your next Draw Phase.

Common.name: Hidden Parasite
Common.desc: Once per turn, you can change all monsters on the field to Insect until the end of this turn, also any battle damage your opponent takes for the rest of this turn is halved. You can only use this Skill up to twice per Duel.

Common.name: Hunting Instinct
Common.desc: When a monster(s) is Special Summoned to your opponent's field (except during the Damage Step): Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand.

Common.name: Hyper Hammerhead
Common.desc: At the end of the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster that battled this card is not destroyed: Return that opponent's monster to the hand.

Common.name: Hyper Metamorphosis
Common.desc: You can activate this Skill while you control a Level 3 or lower Insect Normal Monster. Discard 2 cards and Tribute 1 Level 3 or lower Insect Normal Monster you control to Special Summon 1 "Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth" from your hand or Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. Any damage your opponent takes for the rest of this turn is halved.

Common.name: Insect Neglect
Common.desc: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: You can banish 1 Insect monster from your GY; negate the attack.

Common.name: Insect Princess
Common.desc: All Insect monsters your opponent controls are changed to Attack Position. If this card destroys an Insect monster by battle: This card gains 500 ATK.

Common.name: Insect Queen
Common.desc: This card gains 200 ATK for each Insect monster on the field. Cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card destroyed an opponent's monster by battle this turn: Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

Common.name: Kumootoko
Common.desc: A massive, intelligent spider that traps enemies with webbing.

Common.name: Laser Cannon Armor
Common.desc: Equip only to an Insect monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

Common.name: Limit Impulse
Common.desc: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY; Special Summon 2 "Soul Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). They cannot be Tributed except for a Tribute Summon.

Common.name: Mad Sword Beast
Common.desc: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Common.name: Man-Eater Bug
Common.desc: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

Common.name: Nightmare Sonic Blast!
Common.desc:
You can activate this Skill while you control "Serpent Night Dragon". Once per turn, you can reveal the top 4 cards of your Deck, and use 1 of the following Skills, depending on the number of monsters revealed.
1: Add one of the revealed cards to your hand.
2: Destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
3+: Apply both effects.
Then, place the rest of the revealed cards on top of your Deck in any order.

Common.name: Order to Smash
Common.desc: Target 1 Level 2 or lower non-Token Normal Monster you control; Tribute that Normal Monster, and if you do, destroy up to 2 Spells/Traps your opponent controls.

Common.name: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth
Common.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Petit Moth" on your 6th turn or later after it was equipped with "Cocoon of Evolution".

Common.name: Petit Moth
Common.desc: This small but deadly creature is better off avoided.

Common.name: Pharaoh's Treasure
Common.desc: Shuffle this card face-up into your Deck. If you draw this face-up card that was added to the Deck by this effect: Send it to the GY, then target 1 card in your GY, except this card; add that target to your hand.

Common.name: Pinch Hopper
Common.desc: When this card you control is sent to your GY: You can Special Summon 1 Insect monster from your hand.

Common.name: Raise Body Heat
Common.desc: Equip only to a Dinosaur monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

Common.name: Reinforcements
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Serpent Night Dragon
Common.desc: A dragon created from the soul of a wicked knight.

Common.name: Spacetime Transcendence
Common.desc: Banish 2 or more Dinosaur monsters from your GY; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand or GY whose Level equals the total Levels of those banished monsters, but it cannot attack this turn.

Common.name: Spider Egg
Common.desc: When your opponent declares a direct attack, while you have 3 or more Insect monsters in your GY: Negate the attack, and if you do, Special Summon 3 "Spider Tokens" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 100/DEF 100) in Attack Position.

Common.name: Summoner's Art
Common.desc: Add 1 Level 5 or higher Normal Monster from your Deck to your hand.

Common.name: Super-Ancient Dinobeast
Common.desc: You can Tribute Summon this card in face-up Attack Position by Tributing 1 Dinosaur monster. When a Dinosaur monster(s) is Special Summoned from your GY while this monster is on the field (except during the Damage Step): You can draw 1 card.

Common.name: Tomozaurus
Common.desc: Small but vicious, this monster even attacks its own kind.

Common.name: Two-Headed King Rex
Common.desc: A powerful monster whose two heads attack as one.

Common.name: Ultra Evolution Pill
Common.desc: Tribute 1 Reptile monster; Special Summon 1 Dinosaur monster from your hand.

Common.name: Uraby
Common.desc: Fast on its feet, this dinosaur rips enemies to shreds with its sharp claws.

Common.name: Verdant Sanctuary
Common.desc: When a face-up Insect monster is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the GY: Its controller can add 1 Insect monster with the same Level as the destroyed monster from their Deck to their hand.

Common.name: White Elephant's Gift
Common.desc: Send 1 face-up non-Effect Monster you control to the GY; draw 2 cards.

Common.name: Winged Cleaver
Common.desc: Few can withstand the scythe-like arms of this dangerous creature.

Common.name: Worm Bait
Common.desc: If you control an Insect monster: Special Summon 2 "Worm Tokens" (Insect/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0). You cannot Normal or Special Summon any Level 3 or 4 monsters the turn you activate this card.

Ultra Rare.name: Jar of Avarice
Ultra Rare.desc: Target 5 cards in your GY, except "Jar of Avarice"; shuffle all 5 into the Deck, then draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Jar of Avarice" per turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Order to Charge
Ultra Rare.desc: Target 1 non-Token Normal Monster you control; Tribute that Normal Monster, and if you do, destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.
